title: AgentSurface
description: GAP-SG-142: shared definitions for the agent-native reshaping layer. Every response envelope may carry an `agent_surface` record once a shaping knob (--select/--fields, --filter, --sort, --dedupe-by, --max-items, --count-only, --truncate-content, --max-output-bytes) is set. Response schemas reference `#/$defs/AgentSurfaceMeta` instead of redeclaring the block, because their root sets `additionalProperties: false` and JSON Schema draft 2020-12 offers no way to admit an undeclared member from outside the document.

AgentSurfaceMeta.description: Record of what the reshaping layer did to this envelope. Present only when at least one knob was set; absent means the envelope is byte-identical to the unshaped contract.

input_count.description: Elements in the result array before shaping. `1` when the envelope carries no result array and was projected as a single object.

output_count.description: Elements emitted after filter, sort, dedupe, limit and projection.

select.description: Keys kept by --select/--fields, in the requested order. Absent keys are skipped rather than emitted as null.

filters.description: Number of --filter predicates applied, conjoined with AND.

max_items.description: Cap requested by --max-items. Applies to EVERY array in the envelope since v1.2.5, not only the primary one; --select, --filter, --sort and --dedupe-by stay on the primary array because they act on element fields, which a secondary collection does not share.

secondary_capped.description: Members other than the primary result array that --max-items shortened (for example `edges` beside `nodes`). Emitted only when at least one was shortened.

count_only.description: True when --count-only replaced the payload with a count. See #/$defs/CountOnlyEnvelope.

content_truncated.description: True when --truncate-content shortened at least one string.

truncate_content.description: Character ceiling requested by --truncate-content. Present only alongside content_truncated.

output_truncated.description: True when --max-output-bytes forced result elements out of the envelope.

dropped.description: Result elements removed to satisfy --max-output-bytes. Present only alongside output_truncated.

max_output_bytes.description: Byte ceiling requested by --max-output-bytes. Present only alongside output_truncated.

aliases_removed.description: Derived arrays dropped because they merely restated the reshaped one (`memories` for `items`, `entities` for `nodes`, and `direct_matches`, `graph_matches` and `related_memories` for `results`). A canonical key serves several subcommands, so no single envelope carries every declared member; only the ones actually present are removed and listed. Emitted only when at least one was present; the members stay in place whenever no knob is set.

CountOnlyEnvelope.description: Payload emitted under --count-only. The command envelope is replaced wholesale, so it validates against this definition rather than against the command schema.

count.description: Result elements surviving filter, dedupe and limit. `1` for an envelope with no result array.

truncated.description: Raised when the byte or content ceiling also fired.

truncated_reason.description: Present only on the parseable stub emitted when even the empty envelope exceeds --max-output-bytes.
